name: Npc Trainer Template
description: A reusable list of trainer-taught spells (cost, skill/level/ability requirements) that can be shared by multiple trainer creatures via creature_template.TrainerTemplateId, instead of repeating the same spell list in npc_trainer for each entry.

fields.name: Entry
fields.help: Trainer template id, referenced from creature_template.TrainerTemplateId (not a creature entry itself).

fields.name: Spell
fields.help: Spell taught by the trainer. Must not be a talent, and must exist / be a valid learnable spell.

fields.name: Spell Cost
fields.help: Copper cost to learn the spell from the trainer.

fields.name: Req Skill Value
fields.help: Minimum skill value required in Req Skill.

fields.name: Req Level
fields.help: Minimum player level required (0 = use the taught spell's own spell level).

fields.name: Req Ability 1
fields.help: Optional prerequisite spell the player must already know.

fields.name: Req Ability 2
fields.help: Optional prerequisite spell the player must already know.

fields.name: Req Ability 3
fields.help: Optional prerequisite spell the player must already know.

fields.name: Condition Id
fields.help: conditions.condition_entry controlling whether this spell is offered to a given player, 0 = always offered.

fields.name: Condition
fields.help: Edit the condition tree referenced by Condition Id.
